caption: The drawing depicts a transparent bell jar with a rounded knob on top, placed on a flat, circular base. Inside the bell jar, there is a ball of string or yarn, which appears grayish in color. A single thread extends from the ball of yarn, passing through a small opening at the top of the bell jar and extending outward, looping slightly and resting on the surface outside the jar. The background is a uniform light beige, and the overall composition is centered with ample negative space surrounding the objects. The artist’s name, “PAUL ROYFINEBARGER,” is inscribed in small capital letters on the lower right side of the drawing.
title: String Bowl
